origins.section: A Pattern Variable Exists Only Where the Match Is Certain
A Pattern Variable Exists Only Where the Match Is Certain
Out of Its Scope, a Pattern Variable's Name Means the Field
Since Java 21 a Pattern of the Declared Type Compiles, and It Is Still False for null

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-negated-or-else: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-negated-or-else: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-negated-or-else: Option c is decided. The page's example has the same shape: L22-27 `if (!(o instanceof String s) || s.isBlank()) {...} else { n = s.length(); } return s.length();`, and the only error is at the final return (L45-46, Scopes.java:12). The use in the else gets no error. L51-53 says s exists "in the `else` of a negated test". L55-56 says the if "falls through, so the final `return s.length()` fails". Reference table L217 and L219 say the same.
recorded.prompt:q-reassigned-captured: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reassigned-captured: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reassigned-captured: Option b is decided. L59-61: "It isn't implicitly final: `s = s.strip()` compiles... Once reassigned, it is no longer effectively final, and a lambda can't capture it." Table L228 gives the javac error for a reassigned variable captured by a lambda.
recorded.prompt:q-field-after-guard: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-field-after-guard: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-field-after-guard: Option b is decided. The page's example has the same shape (L71-78). With a valid value it returns the field: the output at L84 is "800 ms: PT30S", and the only log line at L85 belongs to the -5 s call. L89-91: "After the `if` it would be in scope only if the body couldn't complete, and this body logs and falls through. In both places the name means the field." The no-logging half rests on that example output and on the body running only when the test is true.
recorded.prompt:q-declared-type-null: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-declared-type-null: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-declared-type-null: Option a is decided by analogy. L163-171 shows `headers.get(...) instanceof String id`, and the output at L176-178 is "absent: none" and "null instanceof String: false". L189-190: "`instanceof` is false for `null` whatever the pattern". L181 calls the pattern a null check.

recorded.prompt:q-negated-or-else:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-negated-or-else:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-negated-or-else:a: Refuted. L51 says the scope follows the boolean logic, not the block. The Design Note at L247-249 says Java chose not to scope it "like any declaration, to the block around it". The error at L45-46 shows s is not in scope at the end of the method.
recorded.prompt:q-negated-or-else:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-negated-or-else:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-negated-or-else:b: Refuted. L54-56: "After a statement, `s` exists only if the statement can't finish while the test is false"; the if falls through, so the return fails. Table L219: "not after the `if`".
recorded.prompt:q-negated-or-else:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-negated-or-else:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-negated-or-else:d: Refuted. L52-53 says s is in scope "in the `else` of a negated test", and table L217 gives "in `B`". The else-branch use at L25 draws no error (L40-49). L56 shows the use after the if fails.
recorded.prompt:q-reassigned-captured:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reassigned-captured:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reassigned-captured:a: Refuted. L59-60: "It isn't implicitly final: `s = s.strip()` compiles, unless the pattern says `instanceof final String s`." Table L226-227 says the same.
recorded.prompt:q-reassigned-captured:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reassigned-captured:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reassigned-captured:c: Refuted. L60-61 says the lambda can't capture a reassigned variable, so the code doesn't compile. Table L228's error message, "must be final or effectively final", backs the rule in the option's 'says'.
recorded.prompt:q-reassigned-captured:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reassigned-captured:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reassigned-captured:d: Refuted on compilation by L60-61 and table L228. The page never addresses whether the lambda captures o rather than path, but the claim that it compiles is refuted, and that refutes the option.
recorded.prompt:q-field-after-guard:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-field-after-guard:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-field-after-guard:a: Refuted. L89-91 says that after a fall-through if the name means the field. The output at L84 shows PT30S, the field, rather than the 800 ms option.
recorded.prompt:q-field-after-guard:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-field-after-guard:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-field-after-guard:c: Refuted. L61-62: "A local with the same name is an error... A field with the same name is not." Table L230: "a field `s` | allowed". L92-93: the class compiles.
recorded.prompt:q-field-after-guard:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-field-after-guard:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-field-after-guard:d: Refuted. L92-93: "Without the field, `cannot find symbol` would have caught it. With it, the class compiles under `-Xlint:all` with no warning."
recorded.prompt:q-declared-type-null:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-declared-type-null:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-declared-type-null:b: Refuted. L189-190: "'Unconditional' describes the type only. `instanceof` is false for `null` whatever the pattern, so the variable is never `null`."
recorded.prompt:q-declared-type-null:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-declared-type-null:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-declared-type-null:c: Refuted. L181-182: "Java 16 to 20 rejected a pattern that the declared type already guarantees; Java 21 accepts it." Table L234 says it compiles with --release 21, and the stem says --release 21.
recorded.prompt:q-declared-type-null:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-declared-type-null:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-declared-type-null:d: Refuted. L7 gives the order (it "tests `o`, casts it and binds"), L181 calls the pattern a null check, and the absent case returns the default (L176). One part of the option's 'says' wasn't on the page ("a cast of null wouldn't throw anyway"); that 'says' was reworded afterwards to rely on the page only.
